description: This file centralizes user-visible strings for the Thrones Tic Tac Toe Flutter app to facilitate localization and maintainability. It defines a class with static constants and methods that provide all the textual content used in the UI, including titles, labels, button texts, status messages, menus, and legacy alias fields.

classes.name: AppStrings
classes.description: A class containing static constants and methods for all user-visible strings in the app, enabling easy localization and consistent UI text.

methods.name: tileLabel
methods.description: Returns a label for a tile given its index, e.g., 'Tile 1', 'Tile 2', etc.

methods.name: turn
methods.description: Generates a string indicating the current player's turn, e.g., 'Turn: Player1'.

methods.name: winner
methods.description: Returns a string announcing the winner, e.g., 'Winner: Player1'.

methods.name: victoryMessage
methods.description: Returns a victory message for a given player, e.g., 'Victory to Player1! Reset board to play again.'
